+BluePerch
+blueperch.org
+Year round
+New, launched in September 2026. From their website: BluePerch is a fund that makes grants to high-impact farmed animal advocacy projects.
+We create cost-effective impact for farmed animals by making the grants that other funders cannot - small grants delivered early and fast - and using grants to generate evidence that guides the movement’s funding decisions.
+While we are interested in funding any high-impact farmed animal advocacy project, we have a particular interest in funding:
+• Early-stage projects
+• Time-sensitive policy windows
+• Organisations or projects that fall through the cracks of other animal funders
